## Measurement boundaries and guarantees

<!-- F-003: docs/findings.md. Applies to comparisons / measurements and
engineering guarantees, especially power budgets. The implementer / Codex fills
these fields from source requirements before work; PMO checks consistency;
PO confirms guarantee requirements at the Issue / Human Gate.
Inputs: source requirements / ADR, model or measurement setup and load cases.
Check that comparison assumptions are not copied into product guarantees.
Stop before implementation / routing if a required boundary, measurement point,
load or guarantee basis is missing, inconsistent or unsupported; report to PO
for clarification. Mark inapplicable fields with a reason. -->

- Comparison / measurement boundary conditions (assumptions, range, source):
- Guarantee requirements (required limits / range and source; state separately

  converter input; local GND / datum, units and intervening losses):
- Design load (normal design case, simultaneous loads and basis):
